messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed to 50% for release r2026.03.23 (build abc123). Automated smoke probes: 99.1% pass. Notable signal: synthetic embed probe p95 increased to 720ms (baseline 420ms) in eu-west-1, starting ~14:03 UTC. No 5xx observed. Link: https://telemetry/release/r2026.03.23
Alice M.: Eyeballing the trace, it's a tail latency bump, not failures. Still, p95 jump to 720ms is above our soft threshold of 700ms for embed route.
BenT: I pulled traces — tokenizer step shows a handful of requests hitting a cold code path around the tokenizer service. Example log snippet:
```
2026-03-23T14:03:12Z embed-request id=tx1234 stage=tokenize duration_ms=210
2026-03-23T14:03:12Z embed-request id=tx1235 stage=tokenize duration_ms=680
```
BenT: Looks like a small subset of worker pods had an older image, causing slower tokenization. Could be a staggered pull.
Carla P.: Suggestion: hold rollout at 50% for now, run a focused synthetic rerun in eu-west and do a micro warmup for the tokenizer pool. If p95 remains >700ms for the next 15m we should pin route in eu-west to previous version. Plan:
- Hold rollout (stop bumping to 100%)
- Run synthetic sweep: `deployctl synth-run --route embed-eu --pattern short,small-batch --duration 5m`
- Tokenizer warmup: `opsctl warmup --service tokenizer --region eu-west-1 --workers 10`
- If still >700ms -> pin route `deployctl pin-route --route embed-eu --version v2026-03-22 --reason \"p95 tail\"`
Dmitri K.: I'll kick off the synthetic sweep and warmup now. If pin is needed, I'll create a rollback ticket and call the pin.
ops-bot: Triggered synthetic rerun: run_id=sr-9876, started 2026-03-23T14:06:40Z. Warmup job queued: warmup-443.
BenT: Quick check — no errors in recent logs, only latency. This leans toward transient infra (image pull / warmup) vs model regression.
Alice M.: Agreed. Let's hold and monitor. If the synthetic rerun shows improvement within next 10m, we resume rollout. If not, pin eu-west and open follow-up to trace image rollout gap.
ops-bot: Synthetic run completed: sr-9876 results: p95=510ms (eu-west aggregate), passes baseline checks. Warmup-443 reported success.
Carla P.: Nice, improvement looks solid. Recommendation: keep rollout paused for another 10m to confirm stability, then continue to 100%.
Dmitri K.: Created ticket REL-4231 \"eu-west embed p95 tail during canary\" and added logs/traces. I'll un-pause when we hit stable window. (link: https://issues/release/REL-4231)
Alice M.: Thanks everyone. I'll watch the dashboard for 20m and then resume the final ramp if no regression. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollout remains at 50% (paused by team). Canary cookie: abc123. Monitoring window extended +20m.
notes: decided to hold at 50%, run synthetic rerun and warmup, pin only if p95 >700ms persists; ticket REL-4231 created
